# benign

> (medicine) not dangerous to health; not recurrent or progressive.

> Harmless; favorable; kindly, gentle, or beneficial; not cancerous

> 1. harmless; having little effect
> 2. (of a person's character) kind hearted; nice


## Example

- *I remember my grandfather's face was wrinkled, benign, and calm.*
